name: Teresa Oliveira
bio:
Teresa's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Initially trained as a metalworker in Lisbon, she spent years crafting intricate architectural details. A chance encounter with a local racing team, who needed a skilled hand to repair a damaged chassis, opened her eyes to a new world. The precision and artistry required in motorsport resonated with her deeply, leading her to leave her previous career behind.

At Cavaleiro Sports, Teresa is valued for her meticulous approach and quiet dedication. She thrives on the challenge of transforming blueprints into reality, ensuring every component meets her exacting standards. While not one for the spotlight, her colleagues know that Teresa's craftsmanship is the backbone of many successful race weekends, ensuring the cars are robust and reliable. She values the technical skills of her work, but will always contribute to a team's success however she can.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often tied back with a scarf
physical.description: A practical woman, Teresa has a strong build from years of working with metal.

quirks: Always has a small cup of strong black coffee on her workbench.
Organizes her tools by size and function every morning before starting work.
Humms quietly to herself while welding, usually traditional Portuguese folk songs.
